text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — we're scheduling a targeted KMS & admin entitlement scrub next week. Scope: cross-account KMS grants, ownerless admin bindings, and audit-log preservation. Need owners and a canary plan. Anyone want to own KMS discovery?
kevin: I'll take ownerproof for service accounts. last cycle we matched last_used + token issuance patterns; can reuse.
tara: I'll run KMS grant discovery. snippet: `aws kms list-keys --profile prod --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms list-grants --key-id {}`. Will also correlate with CloudTrail Grant events.
sec-bot: Checklist auto-posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/least-privilege-checklist (added by sec-bot) :white_check_mark:
raj: Are infra-shared keys (cross-acct) in or out? We should keep a TTL'd whitelist with justification. propose fields: key_arn, owner, justification, expiry.
nick: +1 for TTL'd whitelist. Also we should tag every removed binding with remediation ticket id for easy rollback.
olivia: Proposed cadence: Scan Mon, triage Tue, canary PR Wed (10 non-prod principals), monitor 72h, broader apply next Tue. Any objections?
kevin: Add a snapshot step: export current IAM/KMS policies to S3 (versioned, encrypted) before any changes: `./tools/snapshot_policies.sh --out=s3://redwood-audit/backups/qN`.
tara: For CloudTrail export per-key: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:...` — I'll attach those to the GH issue.
sec-bot: Policy reminder: ensure `kms:GrantUsage`, `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:ReEncrypt*` are logged. See diff: https://redwood.internal/policies/kms-audit-v2.1.md
raj: Canary PR template: only touch non-prod bindings, add `remediation:revert-if-fail` label, require 2 approvers for org/billing roles. Also require infra+sec eng in approvers for high-risk roles.
nick: I'll wire the canary PR CI to run smoke auth tests and a revert-if-fail action. If smoke fails, label triggers auto-revert.
olivia: Who runs scans? kevin ownerproof, tara KMS. Please post CSVs to GH #4987 by Tue EOD.
kevin: Running ownerproof Tue 09:00 PT. Using filter: role LIKE '%admin%' OR role IN ('org-admin','billing-admin') AND last_used_at < now() - interval '90 days'. Will produce explain output from access-lint.
tara: Running KMS discovery Tue 11:00 PT. I'll produce infra_whitelist.json with key_arn, justification, owner, expiry.
ops-bot: Reminder: schedule maintenance window if applying changes to non-prod accounts.
raj: Add a step to export related CloudTrail events for affected principals for 90d into the GH issue for evidence.
kevin: Also include a dry-run mode in remediation script and a quick fallback: `--dry-run` then `--apply`; `--revert` to re-add bindings using snapshot if needed.
sec-bot: Don't forget to rotate any temporary keys created during remediation. Also keep key policies unchanged unless explicitly remediating them.
nick: I'll add a CI step that validates KMS grants don't break E2E encrypt/decrypt flows against a canary bucket.
olivia: Rollback plan summary: 1) Re-add bindings from snapshot, 2) Restore from S3 if snapshots missing, 3) Open incident if widespread auth failures, 4) Postmortem.
kevin: I'll export token issuance logs correlated with svc accounts for last 90d as supporting evidence.
tara: I'll include CloudTrail per-key filters and tag any key in whitelist with `exempt:access-review` + expiry.
raj: Final ask: require at least one infra eng + one sec eng sign-off for billing/org-admin role changes. Add that to template.
olivia: Done — owners: kevin(ownerproof), tara(KMS discovery), nick(canary PR+CI), raj(approval policy). Meeting Thu to check progress. Thanks.
ops-bot: Scheduled reminder in #eng-security for Tue 08:55 PT (scan kick-off).
